description.description: What the template is for, shown to whoever uses it.

name.description: What `debug: console` calls a card built from this template; it can use the card's variables.

category.description: Groups templates in the picker - "Rooms", "Badges" - for dashboards with many.

publish.description: Lists the template as a card of its own in Home Assistant's add-card dialog; a string names the entry.

deprecated.description: Says the template is on its way out - `true`, or a message saying what to use instead. Not inherited.

examples.description: Sets of variables the template is shown working with: checked by the health panel, offered by the editors.

on_error.description: What a card using this template shows instead of an error, unless the card says otherwise.

suggest_for.description: Which entities Home Assistant's add-card dialog offers this template for.

extends.description: The template this one builds on: its content underneath, this one's last word on top. A list builds on several, left to right, each later one over the ones before.

variables.description: The variables the template takes, described so its editor can offer real controls.

anyOf.description: The variables the template takes, described so its editor can offer real controls.
The same declarations keyed by name: a scalar or list is the default, a mapping is the whole declaration, null is a bare name.

defaults.description: `default:` spelled plural, read the same - the two are merged, `default:` winning a name both set.

let.description: Values the template computes for itself from the others - `room_slug: '[[room|slug]]'` written once instead of the chain repeated everywhere. Template internals: an instance cannot override one.

item.description: A piece of config rather than a card - one entry of a camera card's `cameras:`, say - filled in where a placeholder asks for it: `[[name|with:...]]` once, `[[name|repeat:...]]` once per item. Takes `default:`, `let:` and `variables:` like any template.

group.description: Cards that take their places in the section one by one, as if each were written there.

grid_options.description: How much of a sections grid a card built from this template asks for.

selector.description: A Home Assistant selector, in the same shape ha-form takes.

defaults.description: `default:` spelled plural, read the same; `default:` wins when both are written.

required.description: Whether the template is unusable without it. Warns; it never blocks a save.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match. Warns; it never blocks a save.

allowed.description: The values this variable can take. Warns; it never blocks a save.

group.description: Declarations sharing a group fold into one collapsible section of the editor.

type.description: What kind of value it takes - see VARIABLE_TYPES - which picks its editor control.

domain.description: `type: entity`: the domains it may come from, one or a list.

device_class.description: `type: entity`: the device class it must have, one or a list.

min.description: `type: number`: the range, the step between values, and the unit shown beside it.

multiline.description: `type: text`: a box with room for more than one line.

text_with_placeholders.description: Text, with any number of [[placeholders]]. Each placeholder is a variable name, then steps the card knows, then an optional ?.

config_with_placeholders.description: Card, row, badge or element configuration. Strings in it may hold [[placeholders]].
